description: This file defines a React context for managing and toggling a theme ('light' or 'dark') in a React application. It includes a provider component to supply theme state and persists the theme choice in local storage, as well as a custom hook for consuming the theme context.

methods.name: ThemeProvider
methods.description: React component that provides theme context to its children, manages theme state, and syncs it with document attributes and local storage.

methods.name: useTheme
methods.description: Custom hook that accesses the theme context, allowing components to get current theme info and toggle the theme.
